Row.Text: There are some ruins around here. The settlers believe these ruins have some cultural origins about the previous inhabitants, but the ruins here contain precious metals we need to build up our infrastructure. What do you suppose we do?
Maybe we can preserve some of the important writings and salvage the rest of it.
Important minerals are better than some crummy scratches.
